items.title: Collective Ai Tools
items.content_text:
### Business

*   [Ginta](https://ginta.app/) - AI website builder for small businesses: describe the business and get a live website with contact forms, bookings, an online shop and a blog; Claude and ChatGPT can build sites through its MCP server. `#freemium` `#nocode`

### Chatbots

*   [Castlori](https://castlori.com/chat) - AI character chat for adult writers to rehearse scenes and dialogue with a free Castlori account and a supported model connection. `#free` `#writing`

### Developer Tools

*   [Kling AI Plugin](https://kling.ai/mcp/plugin) - Official OAuth MCP Plugin for Kling image and video generation; choose the Global endpoint or [China endpoint](https://klingai.com/mcp/plugin). Usage consumes Kling credits. [Setup guide](https://kling.ai/app/mcp/guide). `#mcp` `#video` `#image`
*   [Orbi](https://orbi.build/) - Open-source agent that takes a labeled GitHub issue to a reviewed, merged pull request and a tagged release; also runs ops tickets. `#freemium` `#opensource`
*   [Taskhold](https://taskhold.com/?ref=collective-ai-tools) - Hosted task list shared with Claude Code, Cursor and Codex over MCP: agents plan steps, report live progress and ask when stuck, and you watch a live board. Paid, 7-day trial. `#paid` `#mcp`

### Finance

*   [Options Matrix Pro](https://www.optionsmatrixpro.com/) - Connect Claude or ChatGPT via MCP to scan watchlists, check live quotes, or model strategies in plain English (paid plans from $10/month with a 7-day All Access trial, card required, and MCP access on All Access or the trial). `#paid` `#mcp`

### Human Resources

*   [Aethel](https://aethel.pro/practice) - Free AI interview practice for developers: four questions about your real work for your role and level, with a quick check on each answer, no account. `#free`

### Productivity

*   [Enhanciar](https://enhanciar.in/) - A company brain that answers from your Slack, Gmail, Notion and Drive with the source, then drafts the reply or ticket for you to approve. `#paid`

### Real Estate

*   [October](https://www.october-ai.com/) - iPhone app that guides a walk through a home, rental or venue and returns listing photos and a walkthrough video; for agents, Airbnb hosts and small hotels. `#freemium`

### SEO

*   [Can AI Bots Read My Site? by Mydentify](https://mydentify.com/tools/ai-crawler-access-checker) - Free checker that reads robots.txt and page-level directives, then tests whether OpenAI and Anthropic crawlers can reach a public page; it reports search, user-requested retrieval, and training access separately. `#free` `#seo`

### Video

*   [Crisp Video](https://crispvideo.app/) - Restores, denoises and upscales old video and VHS transfers up to 4K offline on a Mac or Windows PC, with a timeline editor. `#freemium` `#video`
*   [iArt](https://www.iart.ai/) - Creates motion graphics videos from a text prompt, refined through chat edits, for logo animations, kinetic typography and explainers. `#freemium`
*   [i2v.ai](https://i2v.ai) - Image and video generation API for developers: one endpoint and one key covering 12 image models and 16 video models, with a USD quote returned before each paid task and an optional per-task spending cap. `#paid` `#api`

items.title: Awesome Go
items.content_text:
### Artificial Intelligence

*   [codex-sdk-go (⭐25)](https://github.com/pmenglund/codex-sdk-go) - Go SDK for the OpenAI Codex app-server with streaming, approval callbacks, and structured output.
*   [KafClaw (⭐21)](https://github.com/KafClaw/KafClaw) - Agent runtime that connects AI agents through Kafka topics, with groups, an orchestrator, shared memory and skill routing.

### Goroutines

*   [agilePool (⭐321)](https://github.com/Yiming1997/agilePool) - Goroutine pool with adaptive worker scaling, bounded concurrency, and overflow task buffering.

items.title: Awesome Rust
items.content_text:
### Applications

*   [localixai/localix-cli (⭐369)](https://github.com/localixai/localix-cli) - A terminal coding agent and agent runtime for CI and scripts, on any hosted or local model; one binary, command `llx` [![CI](https://github.com/localixai/localix-cli/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/localixai/localix-cli/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

### Applications / Text editors

*   [FluxCode (⭐114)](https://github.com/MuaraAI/FluxCode) - A lightweight native code editor for Windows, macOS and Linux built on GPUI (\~50 ms startup, 1.4 MB idle RAM) with an integrated AI agent workspace (ACP), Git, and Python terminal. [![Build](https://github.com/MuaraAI/FluxCode/actions/workflows/build.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/MuaraAI/FluxCode/actions/workflows/build.yml)

### Applications / Workflow Automation

*   [holon-run/holon (⭐199)](https://github.com/holon-run/holon) \[[holon](https://crates.io/crates/holon)] - Local-first Rust workbench for always-on AI agents with explicit work items, event-driven wait/wake, and isolated git worktrees. [![CI](https://github.com/holon-run/holon/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/holon-run/holon/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

### Development tools / Workflow Automation

*   [gbenm/fire (⭐1)](https://github.com/gbenm/fire) \[[fire-cli](https://crates.io/crates/fire-cli)] - Config-first task runner: YAML commands with dynamic shell completion, detachable pty sessions, and an MCP server so AI agents run your project's commands [![build badge](https://github.com/gbenm/fire/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/gbenm/fire/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

### Libraries / Audio and Music

*   [Remade-With-Rust/rusty-opus (⭐7)](https://github.com/Remade-With-Rust/rusty-opus) \[[rusty-opus](https://crates.io/crates/rusty-opus)] - Pure-Rust Opus audio codec (RFC 6716): encoder and decoder. [![build badge](https://github.com/Remade-With-Rust/rusty-opus/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/Remade-With-Rust/rusty-opus/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
*   [Remade-With-Rust/rusty\_flac (⭐2)](https://github.com/Remade-With-Rust/rusty_flac) \[[rusty\_flac](https://crates.io/crates/rusty_flac)] - Pure-Rust FLAC encoder and decoder.

### Libraries / Image processing

*   [Remade-With-Rust/rusty\_dds (⭐3)](https://github.com/Remade-With-Rust/rusty_dds) \[[rusty\_dds](https://crates.io/crates/rusty_dds)] - Pure-Rust DDS texture toolkit: container parse, decode, encode, and GPU upload plans.
*   [Remade-With-Rust/rusty\_jpeg (⭐2)](https://github.com/Remade-With-Rust/rusty_jpeg) \[[rusty\_jpeg](https://crates.io/crates/rusty_jpeg)] - Pure-Rust JPEG/MJPEG decoder and encoder.

### Libraries / Memory management

*   [Remade-With-Rust/rusty\_alloc (⭐20)](https://github.com/Remade-With-Rust/rusty_alloc) \[[rusty\_alloc](https://crates.io/crates/rusty_alloc)] - Pure-Rust allocator (a remake of mimalloc) with a no\_std core. [![build badge](https://github.com/Remade-With-Rust/rusty_alloc/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/Remade-With-Rust/rusty_alloc/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

### Libraries / Parsing

*   [Mattbusel/remoteid (⭐1)](https://github.com/Mattbusel/remoteid) \[[remoteid](https://crates.io/crates/remoteid)] - `no_std` decoder for ASTM F3411 / ASD-STAN drone Remote ID broadcast frames (Bluetooth and Wi-Fi), with DRIP authentication (RFC 9575) checks. [![build badge](https://github.com/Mattbusel/remoteid/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/Mattbusel/remoteid/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

### Libraries / Video

*   [Remade-With-Rust/remade\_ffmpeg\_rs (⭐18)](https://github.com/Remade-With-Rust/remade_ffmpeg_rs) \[[rff-core](https://crates.io/crates/rff-core)] - Ground-up Rust remake of FFmpeg for decode, encode, transcode, mux, and probe. [![build badge](https://github.com/Remade-With-Rust/remade_ffmpeg_rs/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/Remade-With-Rust/remade_ffmpeg_rs/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
*   [Remade-With-Rust/rusty\_h264 (⭐15)](https://github.com/Remade-With-Rust/rusty_h264) \[[rusty\_h264](https://crates.io/crates/rusty_h264)] - Pure-Rust H.264 encoder and decoder. [![build badge](https://github.com/Remade-With-Rust/rusty_h264/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/Remade-With-Rust/rusty_h264/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
*   [Remade-With-Rust/rusty\_h265 (⭐4)](https://github.com/Remade-With-Rust/rusty_h265) \[[rusty\_h265](https://crates.io/crates/rusty_h265)] - Pure-Rust HEVC / H.265 video decoder. [![build badge](https://github.com/Remade-With-Rust/rusty_h265/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/Remade-With-Rust/rusty_h265/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

items.title: Open Source Mac Os Apps
items.content_text:
### 🎵 Audio (77)

*   [AudioEnhancerMAX (⭐8)](https://github.com/sev7enITA/AudioEnhancerMAX) - Audio editor with local processing, reviewable non-destructive edits, and traceable processing reports. ([Website](https://fabriziodegni.com/AudioEnhancerMAX/)) — `Python` `JavaScript`

### 🎧 Music (23) / ✏️ Text (19)

*   [PitchTap (⭐1)](https://github.com/gkudva96/pitchtap) - Menu bar app that changes the key of any app's audio live, such as Spotify or Apple Music, without changing the tempo. — `Swift` `C++` `C`
*   [NotchMuse (⭐10)](https://github.com/Xiye88/NotchMuse) - Synced lyrics for Spotify, Apple Music, NetEase Cloud Music, QQ Music and Soda Music in the macOS menu bar, beside the notch, or above the Dock. ([Website](https://notchmuse.com)) — `Swift`

### ⏱️ Productivity (183) / ✏️ Text (19)

*   [Shiyin (⭐184)](https://github.com/juinwei7/Shiyin) - Meeting notes app that records Zoom, Meet and Teams without a bot, transcribes on-device with whisper.cpp, identifies speakers, and writes timestamped notes with your own Claude or ChatGPT. ([Website](https://shiyin.weibuilds.com)) — `Swift`
*   [ThunderTalk (⭐18)](https://github.com/realAllenSong/ThunderTalk) - On-device voice input: press a key, speak Chinese or English, text lands at the cursor. Also transcribes links, reads aloud and composes songs. ([Website](https://realallensong.github.io/ThunderTalk/)) — `Python`
*   [Voltip (⭐106)](https://github.com/sunerpy/voltip) - Push-to-talk dictation that inserts text at the cursor, with on-device or cloud speech recognition, optional AI polish, a personal dictionary and an Android phone that can act as the microphone. ([Website](https://voltip.firlab.app/)) — `Rust` `TypeScript`
*   [CoWork OS (⭐554)](https://github.com/CoWork-OS/CoWork-OS) - Open-source desktop AI agent for files, browser and chat-app tasks that works with your own API keys or local models through Ollama and MLX. ([Website](https://coworkosapp.com)) — `TypeScript`
*   [Codealong (⭐72)](https://github.com/codealong/codealong) - Mac app that tracks every Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Antigravity and Cursor session on your machine, grouped by repo, worktree and PR, with notch and floating-bar approvals, automated draft PR reviews, and plan usage per account. ([Website](https://www.codealong.com)) — `Rust` `TypeScript`
*   [Orca (⭐133k)](https://github.com/stablyai/orca) - AI orchestrator that runs Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode or Pi side-by-side, each in its own git worktree and tracked in one place. ([Website](https://onorca.dev)) — `TypeScript`
*   [Perch (⭐31)](https://github.com/asafofer/perch) - Keyboard-first MacBook notch app for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and pi sessions: see what each did, answer from the notch, and jump back to the exact window or terminal pane. ([Website](https://perchapp.dev)) — `Swift` `JavaScript`
*   [Spyhop (⭐11)](https://github.com/leeleelee3264/spyhop) - Board that shows every running Claude Code, Codex and OMP session with its progress as steps (done, now, next), putting sessions that wait for input on top. ([Website](https://leeleelee3264.github.io/spyhop/)) — `Python` `Swift`
*   [Dayside (⭐10)](https://github.com/ninondev/Dayside) - Menu bar world clock that paints each city's row in its real sky color and finds meeting times across time zones. — `Swift` `Rust`
*   [Kurenai (⭐6)](https://github.com/Lorder19/kurenai) - Clipboard history with search, saved snippet lists and a paste queue that pastes copied items one by one with Cmd+V. Skips passwords and keeps history encrypted. ([Website](https://lorder19.github.io/kurenai/)) — `Swift`
*   [Koru (⭐46)](https://github.com/koruworks/mono) - Local-first workspace for notes, docs and files with terminal tabs and a local MCP server. No account required; imports Evernote, Notion, OneNote, Google Docs and Markdown. ([Website](https://www.koru.do)) — `Rust`
*   [GlideDeck (⭐18)](https://github.com/nirlotan/GlideDeck) - Zooming presentations on an infinite canvas, with PowerPoint import and export. ([Website (⭐18)](https://github.com/nirlotan/GlideDeck)) — `Rust`

### 📊 Menubar (203) / ✏️ Text (19)

*   [Switchboard (⭐6)](https://github.com/justadityaraj/switchboard-browser-picker) - Menu-bar browser picker that opens each link in the right browser, Chrome or Brave profile, or private window, with rules by site, URL or source app and built-in link cleanup. ([Website](https://dev.adityarajsingh.com/switchboard/)) — `Swift`
*   [AgentBar (⭐15)](https://github.com/michalstrnadel/AgentBar) - Menu bar and notch status for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot CLI and others), with Allow and Deny for Claude Code, Codex and Copilot permission requests. ([Website](https://michalstrnadel.com/agentbar)) — `Swift` `JavaScript`
*   [OpusBar (⭐13)](https://github.com/kushalBanda/OpusBar) - A cat in your menu bar that watches your Claude Code and Codex sessions: it takes on the state of the most urgent one, flags the session that needs you, and tracks plan limits and billing. ([Website](https://kushalbanda.com/opusbar/)) — `Swift`
*   [AI Usage (⭐10)](https://github.com/neoromantic/ai-usage) - Menu bar app and CLI that show how much Claude Code, Codex and Grok quota is left on each machine and whether it lasts until the reset. ([Website](https://au.sergeybaus.com)) — `Go` `Swift`
*   [ccx (⭐16)](https://github.com/aaronwong1999/ccx) - Menu bar app that hands a Claude Code session to Codex (and back) with the full context, so you keep working when one side hits its usage limit. ([Website (⭐16)](https://github.com/aaronwong1999/ccx)) — `Swift` `Python`
*   [Loom (⭐4)](https://github.com/chaiwithcode/Loom) - Native read-only macOS menu-bar monitor for Codex, Claude Code and Antigravity sessions, repositories, lifecycle states and provider health. ([Website](https://chaiwithcode.github.io/Loom/)) — `Swift`
*   [Arras (⭐59)](https://github.com/yashashwi-s/Arras) - Desktop photo widgets and editable collages with slideshows and adjustable layers. ([Website](https://tryarras.tech/)) — `Swift`
*   [Deploylight (⭐32)](https://github.com/andrewk17/deploylight) - Vercel and Cloudflare deploy status in your Mac menu bar. ([Website](https://deploylight.akim.workers.dev/)) — `Swift`
*   [SpotAsk (⭐22)](https://github.com/shiquda/SpotAsk) - One hotkey to ask any AI from the Mac menu bar: in-app answers with your own API key, or smart routing to web AI, CLI agents and desktop apps. ([Website](https://shiquda.github.io/SpotAsk/)) — `Swift`

### 💬 Chat (29)

*   [FinchGram (⭐13)](https://github.com/FinchGram/FinchGram) - Unofficial Telegram client built on TDLib, with a screenshot tool, WebDAV downloads and opt-in MCP access for AI assistants. ([Website](https://www.finchgram.com)) — `Rust`

### 🗄️ Database (21)

*   [DBine (⭐41)](https://github.com/addlayer-io/dbine) - Database manager for 130+ SQL and NoSQL databases and cloud services, with notebooks, schema and data compare, and a local MCP server. ([Website](https://dbine.com)) — `Rust` `TypeScript`

### 📺 Terminal (32) / ✏️ Text (19)

*   [agent-manager (⭐703)](https://github.com/wainmann/agent-manager) - Terminal UI that runs Claude Code, Codex and other coding-agent CLIs side by side in persistent tmux sessions, with live status and diff review. ([Website](https://agent-manager.dev)) — `Go`
*   [Unterm (⭐24)](https://github.com/zhitongblog/unterm) - GPU-accelerated terminal that runs a local MCP server so AI coding agents can open panes, run commands and read the screen, and shows the state of agents running in its panes. ([Website](https://unterm.app)) — `Rust`

### 🛠️ Utilities (261) / ✏️ Text (19)

*   [Stackyard (⭐92)](https://github.com/AqibJavedZeepalm/stackyard) - Shows every installed SDK and toolchain version (Flutter, Node.js, Android SDK, Xcode simulators, Java, Python, .NET), which local projects use each one, and cleans up the ones nothing needs. ([Website](https://aqibjaved.dev/apps/stackyard/)) — `Dart`
*   [JsonStudio (⭐197)](https://github.com/sundegan/JsonStudio) - Local-first JSON workspace for formatting, editing, diffing, converting, validating, and extracting JSON from logs. ([Website](https://jsonstudio.js.org/)) — `Rust` `TypeScript` `Svelte`
*   [Glim (⭐47)](https://github.com/NeoPanic/Glim) - Free, open-source macOS file viewer for Markdown, PDFs, images, JSON, CSV and source code in one workspace. ([Website (⭐47)](https://github.com/NeoPanic/Glim)) — `Rust` `Swift`
*   [MD QuickLook (⭐16)](https://github.com/armamut/md-quicklook) - Native Quick Look extension for Markdown with GFM, syntax highlighting, math, Mermaid diagrams and Finder thumbnails, without a web engine. ([Website (⭐16)](https://github.com/armamut/md-quicklook)) — `Swift` `Rust`
*   [Folderglass (⭐15)](https://github.com/justadityaraj/folderglass) - Quick Look extension for folders: real size including subfolders, file-type breakdown, largest and newest files, git branch and status, and the README rendered inline. Also previews zip contents and Markdown. ([Website](https://dev.adityarajsingh.com/folderglass/)) — `Swift`
*   [Kumquat (⭐29)](https://github.com/iandifilippo/Kumquat) - Convert or edit any file mid-drag: tap Shift and drop it on a ring of formats and tools. ([Website](https://iandifilippo.github.io/Kumquat/)) — `Swift`
*   [Swivel (⭐30)](https://github.com/jonathanlotan/Swivel) - Menu bar app that opens a radial menu while you drag files in Finder, to convert, resize, compress or OCR them offline. ([Website](https://jonathanlotan.github.io/Swivel/)) — `Swift`
*   [Convertino (⭐21)](https://github.com/hasanzadee/convertino) - Drag a file, tap Shift and drop it on a radial menu to convert or edit it: images, PDF, video, OCR and offline background removal. — `C#`
*   [IconCraft (⭐15)](https://github.com/gshipman223/IconCraft) - Give any app a custom name and icon, safely and reversibly, without changing the app underneath. ([Website](https://iconcraft.co)) — `Go` `JavaScript`
*   [DockPin (⭐6)](https://github.com/kangaroo-demo/DockPin) - Menu bar utility that helps keep the macOS Dock on a chosen display in multi-monitor setups. ([Website](https://kangaroo-demo.github.io/DockPin/)) — `Swift`
*   [Glance (⭐17)](https://github.com/glanceformac/glance) - Turns the MacBook notch into a live island with music and synced lyrics, Cinema mode that makes the screen and Touch Bar glow with Chrome video, Claude Code approvals, a teleprompter, a file shelf and keep awake. ([Website](https://glanceformac.vercel.app)) — `Swift`
